description_en: Performs a pagination query to retrieve the names of protected objects
description_zh: 分页查询防护对象名称列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-resource-names --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-9lb00005s03 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDefenseResourceNames

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the protected object that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的防护对象名称
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en: The page number of the paginated results. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第 1 页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20, which indicates 20 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为20，表示每页包含 20 条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: The Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
